answer.grain: individual trade prints (microsecond timestamps), i.e. strictly below second level; a second-level or coarser path is a truncation of it

api.print_filter: factory/scripts/basket_t5_rawpaths.py :: price_updating(frame) (= factory/scripts/sip_bars.py :: combine(conditions, tape) strictest-rule-wins, keep hl == 2)
api.substrate_chain: raw SIP prints (this probe) -> sip_bars.build_bars -> sip_netbars.py net bars -> basket_anatomy.py anatomy jsonl; basket_anatomy.py itself consumes minute BARS, not prints, so the print-level API above is the only raw-print entry point
api.manifest: {trades_root}/<YYYY-MM-DD>.manifest.json (rows, window, sha256, schema, min/max ts per day)

condition_policy.rule: strictest rule wins across a print's condition codes; a print is eligible for the path iff its high-low rule is 2 (sip_bars.combine)
condition_policy.tape_dependent: 'B' updates high/low on tape C but not on tape A/B (average-price trade)
condition_policy.print_side: a raw print is not necessarily a plain trade: odd lots (I), derivatively priced (4), prior reference (P), official/auction (Q, M, O, 5, 6), odd-lot+reopen combos appear with their own prices; the policy above decides which of them move the path

not_reconstructible_locally: the mutual order of prints sharing one microsecond (8.8%-style ties): file order is the only order, trade_id is not monotone inside ties
a price for a minute that has no price-updating print: there is nothing to reconstruct, and any value there is a provider-bar fill
exchange matching-engine timestamps (the tape carries feed print timestamps)

runner.rule: argmax max A_pm top-3 mfe over dev days

halt.rule: argmax sum of halt-shaped print holes (>= 5-minute print-to-print jumps) of the A_pm top-3 inside their windows, among days where every member prints in >= 60 minutes
halt.tie_break: larger single hole, then earliest day

ordinary.rule: zero print gaps (no >= 2-minute hole, anatomy gap_post = 0); max member mfe closest to the median of that statistic over all such days

full_universe_1066.note: binary estimate = 20 B/print (int64 ts + float32 px + float32 sz + code byte); reconstruct = read + price_updating + per-member minute aggregation, measured on the cost-sample days; probe_verify adds the tie/gap/bar-reconciliation checks

cost_model.note: read cost = one projected-column scan of the whole day file per day; the symbol filter runs after the read (no row-group pruning guarantee), so this is an upper bound on a member-only extraction. Times are warm-cache single-process measurements with no competing load; expect run-to-run variance well above the clock resolution, so read p10/p50/p90 above are the honest summary, not a point estimate.

caveats: the tape is a raw print stream, not a trade-only stream: prints whose conditions do not update high/low are excluded from the path by the canonical policy - 1764233 of 2968612 window prints (59.4%) in the 9 probe member-days; dominant excluded combos: @|I (1183260), @|F|I (576285), @|4|I (4457), @|4|W (127)

prints at the same microsecond (groups of up to 5 in the probe) have no recoverable mutual order: trade_id is not monotone inside ties (1540 such groups), so file order is the only order available. Per-second and per-minute high/low are unaffected (verified against the committed bars); open/close of a second or minute can differ by the tie-break rule only where the bucket's first or last microsecond is a multi-price tie: 1928 seconds and 2 minutes of 3500 probe minutes

a minute with no price-updating print has no raw open/close at all: any fill or valuation there is a provider-bar fill, not a print (0 such bar-minutes in these 9 member-days); on thin/halted names they are the norm, not the exception
one day file holds the whole net universe (median 35.1 MB): a per-day member extraction reads the whole day file unless row-group pruning on `symbol` applies

IEX is not a sub-minute source locally: data/iex_tape/ holds minute bars (668 days, 2024-01 onward) of IEX-only prints; IEX is a single venue, a strict subset of SIP, so IEX-only prices can differ from the consolidated SIP print at the same second
timestamps are the feed's print timestamps (microsecond resolution), not exchange matching-engine timestamps; they are the only ordering evidence in the file

a run of minutes with no price-updating print is a halt signature (halts stop prints) but illiquidity produces the same signature; the tape does carry reopen labels - a print with condition code 5 (market-center reopening) follows 53of 103 halt-sized holes in the probe; the rest are indistinguishable from illiquidity, and the ordinary day has no holes at all
excluded-print counts rely on the (ts_utc, trade_id, price) key being unique inside the window: measured duplicates = 0
